imageQa.note: Intentional image-free layouts; no new or changed editorial, affiliate or product imagery. The dress-trouser guide uses accurate category text links only.

searchConsole.signal: Eight homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 3.125 and no query rows
searchConsole.decision: The sample is too small and queryless to support a Data-led page. Today's portfolio therefore expands three established but distinct clusters and reinforces crawl paths without inventing a search opportunity.
searchConsole.ignored: The eight homepage impressions, aggregate average position and lack of query rows were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for title chasing, keyword expansion or a topical pivot.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed, sponsored/nofollow text recommendations appear only on the dress-trouser guide: wool and wool-blend trousers, washable dress trousers and pleated dress trousers. Identity-theft recovery and treadmill qualification remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy identity-theft recovery control record that separates exposure from confirmed misuse and tracks accounts, evidence, official reports, freezes, disputes, tax protection, deadlines and written closure.
authority.cluster: Identity and household-finance authority, with reciprocal contextual links from the credit-freeze, digital-account-recovery, checking-account and debt-collection guides; Style fit and Fitness equipment clusters also gain reciprocal paths.
authority.opportunity: Identity Theft Resource Center victim-services educators and state consumer-protection educators logged as qualified accuracy-and-implementation opportunities; no outreach sent.

diversity: The portfolio answers three unrelated questions across Life, Style and Fitness: how to control recovery after identity misuse, how to buy and alter dress trousers, and how to qualify a motorized treadmill for a real room. One is a noncommercial authority asset, one serves apparel purchase intent, and one explores high-consequence home-fitness compatibility; none is driven by the weak Search Console sample.
